item.title: OpenAI disables ChatGPT app suggestions that looked like ads
item.description:
📝 SHARE OpenAI has disabled a feature in ChatGPT that suggested third-party applications after users complained the recommendations resembled advertisements. People trust ChatGPT and anything we do will be designed to respect that. The Wall Street Journal reported this week that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued a “code red” memo.
🔗 Read more: https://techoreon.com/openai-disables-chatgpt-app-suggestions-ads-backlash/
